name: Say text
description: Synthesises speech from text and returns it inline as base64 bytes, for an app that plays it at once. Nothing is stored and the operation is a read, so no job record keeps the words or the audio. The local engine speaks WAV (its default) with a numbered voice; another engine's default format is Ogg/Opus. Returns {bytes, size, mediaType, format, voice, model, engine}. To keep the audio as a file, such as a voice note to send, use speech:speak.

voice.description: Voice: a name for a provider elsewhere, a number such as 0 for the local engine; defaults to the venue's configured voice.

model.description: Speech model; defaults to the venue's configured model, the only one the local engine runs.

format.description: Audio format: wav from the local engine, which makes nothing else; opus (Ogg/Opus) by default elsewhere.

language.description: The text's language as a code such as en or fr, for the local engine (default en); others ignore it.

instructions.description: Optional guidance on tone or delivery, for models that take it; the local engine does not.

apiKey.description: Optional s/NAME reference to the caller's own key; by default the operator's key, else the caller's s/OPENAI_API_KEY, else none. The local engine needs none.
